criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a new user, when they sign up using email, then they should be able to log in successfully.
Given a user, when they forget their password, then they should be able to reset it.
Trust: User credentials are securely stored and transmitted.
Given a user, when they open the app, then they should see a feed of properties with key details.
Given a property, when it is saved, then it should appear in the user's favorites.
Trust: Property data is fetched from the MLS and displayed accurately.
Given a user, when they search by city, then they should see relevant properties.
Given a user, when they apply a price filter, then only properties within that range should appear.
Trust: Search results are consistent with the MLS data.
Given a property, when viewed, then all details including match score should be visible.
Given a property, when it is not a match, then the user should understand why.
Trust: Match score is calculated based on user preferences and MLS data.
Given a property, when saved, then it should appear in the selected category.
Given a saved property, when removed, then it should no longer appear in favorites.
Trust: Saved properties are stored and retrieved accurately.
Given multiple properties, when compared, then differences should be highlighted.
Given a comparison, when a property is removed, then the comparison updates.
Trust: Comparison data is accurate and up-to-date.
Given a map view, when a user zooms, then properties in the visible area should update.
Given a property marker, when clicked, then a preview should appear.
Trust: Map data is synchronized with MLS listings.
Given a property, when a tour is requested, then the user should receive a confirmation.
Given a tour request, when details are incomplete, then the user should be prompted to complete them.
Trust: Tour requests are logged and confirmed accurately.
Given a user, when they update preferences, then notifications should reflect changes.
Given a notification, when disabled, then it should not be sent.
Trust: Notification settings are stored and applied correctly.
Given a property, when affordability is calculated, then all cost components should be displayed.
Given a calculation, when inputs are changed, then results should update.
Trust: Calculations are accurate and disclaimers are visible.
Given a property, when shared via email, then the recipient should receive the details.
Given a property, when shared via text, then a link should be sent.
Trust: Shared links are valid and lead to the correct property details.
Given sensitive data, when transmitted, then it should be encrypted.
Given an integration, when configured, then it should connect to the correct service.
Trust: Data security measures are in place and integrations are functional.
Given a buyer accesses the profile creation page, When they submit valid information, Then a profile is created successfully
Given a buyer submits incomplete information, When they attempt to create a profile, Then an error message is displayed
Trust: Profile creation actions are logged with a timestamp
Given a user registers, When the registration is successful, Then the action is logged in the audit trail
Given a user requests a password reset, When the reset is initiated, Then the action is logged in the audit trail
Trust: All user actions must be recorded in the audit trail with a timestamp
